title: Gulf Construction | Wider Role For Parsons On Lusail Infrastructure
summary: Parsons Corporation has recently won a three-year contract to provide programme and construction management services for the Lusail City Infrastructure Program, extending its near two-decade partnership with developer Qatari Diar.
